title: The European Charter for Regional or Minority Languages in Hungary

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Hungary signed and ratified the *Regionális vagy Kisebbségi Nyelvek Európai Kartája*, undertaking specific commitments for 14 minority languages (including German, Slovak, Romanian, Serbian, Croatian, Romani, and Boyash).

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Under the Charter, multi-ethnic municipalities must provide bilingual place-name signs (*kétnyelvű helységnévtáblák*), mother-tongue kindergarten instruction, and translation in official local government proceedings.
